Covariance-adjustment specification

Source: R/adjust.R
riposte_adjust.Rd

Bundles the covariates, the learner, and whether to refit per permutation. Pass the result as adjust = to riposte_test(), or pass a bare one-sided covariate formula and let riposte_test() wrap it with the default learner.

Usage

riposte_adjust(covariates, learner = riposte_ridge_learner(), refit = TRUE)

Arguments

covariates

a one-sided formula of covariates, e.g. ~ x1 + x2.

learner

a learner (X, Y, control) -> Yhat; ridge by default. See riposte_ridge_learner().

refit

refit the learner inside every re-randomization (TRUE, exact for any learner) or fit once on the observed controls and permute the fixed residuals (FALSE, the shortcut that breaks exactness when the learner overfits — kept for comparison).

Value

a riposte_adjust specification.
